note_ne: DHM मौसम पूर्वानुमान महाशाखाको साइट dhm.gov.np/mfd खुल्यो; मंसिर ११ बिहान ८ बजे जारी ५ दिने मौसम चेतावनी (१२४५६) सबैभन्दा पछिल्लो हो। नक्सा पढियो: मंसिर ११ देखि मंसिर १५ सम्म पाँचै दिन देशभर हरियो; रातो, सुन्तला वा पहेँलो चेतावनी छैन। नदीको तह यस पटक पुनः जाँचिएको छैन; पछिल्लो अवस्था नदी पृष्ठमा हेर्नुहोस्।
note_en: DHM's forecasting site dhm.gov.np/mfd loaded; the 5-day weather warning issued at 8 AM Mangsir 11 (12456) is the latest. Maps read: green across the country on all five days, Mangsir 11 to Mangsir 15 (27 Nov to 1 Dec); no red, orange or yellow. River levels were not re-checked in this pass; see the Rivers page for the latest.

country.analysis_ne: हाल नेपालमा कुनै पनि मौसमी प्रणालीको उल्लेखनीय प्रभाव रहेको छैन ।
country.analysis_en: Currently, no significant weather system is influencing Nepal.
country.day_ne: कोशी प्रदेशको पहाडी र हिमाली क्षेत्रका साथै बागमती र गण्डकी प्रदेशको हिमाली क्षेत्रमा आंशिक बादल लाग्नेछ, बाँकी क्षेत्रमा मौसम मूख्यतया सफा रहनेछ। कोशी प्रदेशको हिमाली भू-भागका एक-दुई स्थानमा हल्का वर्षा/हिमपातको सम्भावना छ।
country.day_en: Partly cloudy conditions will prevail in the Hilly and Himalayan regions of Koshi Province, as well as in the Himalayan regions of Bagmati and Gandaki Provinces, while the weather will remain mainly fair in the remaining areas. Light rain/snowfall is likely at one or two places in the Himalayan region of Koshi Province.
country.night_ne: कोशी र गण्डकी प्रदेशको हिमाली क्षेत्रमा आंशिक बादल लाग्नेछ, बाँकी क्षेत्रमा मौसम मूख्यतया सफा रहनेछ। बिहानपख उपत्यका र खोँचहरूका साथै तराई भू-भागका थोरै स्थानमा हुस्सु/कुहिरो लाग्नेछ ।
country.night_en: Partly cloudy conditions will prevail in the Himalayan regions of Koshi and Gandaki Provinces, while the weather will remain mainly fair in the remaining areas. Mist/fog is likely at a few places in valleys and river basins, as well as in the Terai regions, during the early morning.
